energy.outlook: Hinkley Point C construction approaching peak — completion targeting 2030-2031. Gravity Enterprise Zone Somerset adjacent to Hinkley establishing EV and clean energy manufacturing. NDA Berkeley and Oldbury decommissioning active. National Grid ED RIIO-ED2 South West £1.5bn. South West Water renewable energy infrastructure.

real-estate.outlook: Bristol Temple Quarter remains the South West's largest regeneration scheme — 10m sqft masterplan with arena, housing, and employment. Bristol Western Harbour planning progressing. Exeter St Davids Gateway in development. Bournemouth and Bath city centre investment active.

rail.outlook: Network Rail Dawlish Resilience Programme delivering sea wall and track protection — critical national infrastructure. MetroWest Bristol suburban rail Phase 2 in OBC development. MetroWest Phase 1 operational with service improvements ongoing. Network Rail CP7 Wales & Western £1.7bn South West element active.

maritime.outlook: Plymouth Freeport and Marine Enterprise Zone progressing with manufacturing and maritime investment. HMNB Devonport infrastructure programme active. Bristol Port Avonmouth industrial investment ongoing. Falmouth Fal Estuary marine energy hub in development for tidal and offshore wind O&M.

utilities.outlook: South West Water and Wessex Water delivering combined £6bn AMP8 programmes. South West Water facing Ofwat scrutiny following pollution incidents — accelerated investment in storm overflows. Somerset Levels Flood Resilience Programme ongoing. South West Coastal Flood Programme active.

highways.outlook: A303 Stonehenge Tunnel in active construction — transformational for SW connectivity. A358 Taunton to Southfields dualling in procurement. A30 and A38 improvement schemes delivering across Cornwall and Devon. M5 connectivity improvements associated with Gravity EZ.
